question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column ‘A’ ‘B’ and ‘C’ to write five complete sentences. 1  5 =
stimulus: Column 'A' Column 'B' Column 'C' (a) Communicative competence i. to the way people i. a language. refers to develop ii. aware of acquiring a language. (b) There are two ii. in which users are not iii. the language to communicate. (c) The first is acquisition which is usually iv. ability in their mother tongue. similar iii. fact that they are using v. appropriately in different (d) It is a natural subconscious iv. ways of learning circumstances. process v. the ability to use (e) They are aware only of the language
guide_solution: (a) Communicative competence refers to the ability to use language appropriately in different circumstances. (b) There are two ways of learning a language. (c) The first is acquisition which is similar to the way people develop ability in their mother tongue. (d) It is a natural subconscious process in which users are not usually aware of acquiring a language. (e) They are aware only of the fact that they are using the language to communicate. → → → → → → →
